sentences.text: Alice Cooper -LRB- born Vincent Damon Furnier ; February 4 , 1948 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter , and actor whose career spans over five decades .	Alice Cooper	Alice Cooper (band)

With his distinctive raspy voice and a stage show that features guillotines , electric chairs , fake blood , deadly snakes , baby dolls , and dueling swords , Cooper is considered by music journalists and peers alike to be `` The Godfather of Shock Rock '' .	Shock Rock	Shock rock
He has drawn equally from horror films , vaudeville , and garage rock to pioneer a macabre and theatrical brand of rock designed to shock people .	vaudeville	vaudeville	garage rock	garage rock

Originating in Phoenix , Arizona , in the late 1960s after he moved from Detroit , Michigan , `` Alice Cooper '' was originally a band consisting of Furnier on vocals and harmonica , lead guitarist Glen Buxton , Michael Bruce on rhythm guitar , Dennis Dunaway on bass guitar , and drummer Neal Smith .	Detroit	Detroit	Michigan	Michigan	Alice Cooper	Alice Cooper (band)	originally a band	Alice Cooper (band)	Glen Buxton	Glen Buxton	Michael Bruce	Michael Owen Bruce	Dennis Dunaway	Dennis Dunaway	Neal Smith	Neal Smith (drummer)

The original Alice Cooper band released its first album in 1969 but broke into the international music mainstream with the 1971 hit `` I 'm Eighteen '' from their third studio album Love It to Death , which was followed by the even bigger single `` School 's Out '' in 1972 .	Alice Cooper	Alice Cooper (band)	Love It to Death	Love It to Death
The band reached their commercial peak with the 1973 album Billion Dollar Babies .	Billion Dollar Babies	Billion Dollar Babies

Furnier adopted the band 's name as his own name in the 1970s and began a solo career with the 1975 concept album Welcome to My Nightmare .	concept album	concept album	Welcome to My Nightmare	Welcome to My Nightmare
In 2011 , he released Welcome 2 My Nightmare , his 19th album as a solo artist and 26th album in total .	Welcome 2 My Nightmare	Welcome 2 My Nightmare
In 2011 , the original Alice Cooper band was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame .	Alice Cooper	Alice Cooper (band)	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

Expanding from his Detroit rock roots , Cooper has experimented with a number of musical styles , including art rock , hard rock , heavy metal , new wave , glam metal , pop rock , experimental rock , and industrial rock . Cooper is known for his social and witty persona offstage , with The Rolling Stone Album Guide calling him the world 's most `` beloved heavy metal entertainer '' .	heavy metal	heavy metal music	The Rolling Stone Album Guide	The Rolling Stone Album Guide

He is credited with helping to shape the sound and look of heavy metal , and has been described as the artist who `` first introduced horror imagery to rock 'n' roll , and whose stagecraft and showmanship have permanently transformed the genre '' .	heavy metal	heavy metal music

Away from music , Cooper is a film actor , a golfing celebrity , a restaurateur , and , since 2004 , a popular radio DJ with his classic rock show Nights with Alice Cooper .	Alice Cooper	Alice Cooper (band)	Nights with Alice Cooper	Nights with Alice Cooper
